description:
Become a GUMMI SOCKS Affiliate

About GUMMI SOCKS

GUMMI SOCKS was born on the reformer after one too many slips. Not good enough.

So we made socks that actually stay put.

Created in the UK, every pair is designed to hug the foot, support the arch, and hold steady through every stretch, shake, and hold. Whether you’re flowing through Pilates, powering through barre, or moving through yoga, GUMMI delivers grip you can trust and comfort you’ll want to wear all day.

Then we made them fun.

Inspired by candy-shop colours and nostalgic favourites, GUMMI brings bold personality to studio wear. Brights, pastels, and unexpected colour combinations designed to stand out - because performance gear doesn’t have to look boring.

Performance that grips. Style that hits.


How Our Affiliate Programme Works

As a GUMMI SOCKS affiliate, you’ll earn 10% commission on every sale made through your unique affiliate link.

You’ll be able to track clicks, sales, and commissions directly within your UpPromote Affiliate dashboard, making it easy to monitor your performance and earnings.


How to Promote GUMMI SOCKS

We want our affiliates to genuinely love and wear our products.

That’s why we provide:

  • Access to a library of brand imagery and marketing assets
  • A gifted pair of GUMMI SOCKS for content creation
  • Ongoing support from our team

We encourage affiliates to share GUMMI in a way that feels authentic to their audience - whether that’s studio content, styling videos, workouts, reviews, or everyday wear.

Join the GUMMI community and help us bring more colour, confidence, and grip to every workout.
payout_period: We pay out earnings once per month. If you would like to request a payout or discuss payment, please contact info@gummisocks.co.uk.
